books.author: Bhumananda

sources.observation: Primary text examination reveals 'স্বামী সারদানন্দ (যেমন দেখিয়াছি)' by Swami Bhumananda is not an independent freestanding monograph; it was originally published serially in Udbodhan Patrika (1334 BS / 1927–1928) and is collected as Chapter 9 (pages 83–94) of the anthology volume 'Swami Saradanander Smritikatha' (Udbodhan Karyalaya, compiled by Swami Chetanananda).

books.text_outcome: no_complete_free_text_verified. Not an independent freestanding monograph in print. Bibliographic examination shows this work consists of reminiscence articles serially published in Udbodhan Patrika after Swami Saradananda's Mahasamadhi and collected as a chapter in Swami Chetanananda's anthology 'Swami Saradanander Smritikatha'. No standalone publisher volume or cover exists.
